* Perform hardware diagnostics, break/fix, and RMA coordination with vendors to minimise downtime
* Support deployment and maintenance of low\-latency networking gear (switches, NICs, optics, transceivers, fiber infrastructure)
* Work closely with network, systems, and trading infrastructure engineers on deployments, upgrades, and capacity planning

* Follow strict change management, security, and compliance processes in a regulated trading environment

* Experience with fiber optics, copper cabling, transceivers, and basic optical testing
* Familiarity with Linux\-based systems and basic CLI troubleshooting
* Understanding of low\-latency requirements and how physical design impacts performance (cable routing, port selection, NIC placement, etc.)
* Ability to work under pressure, prioritise effectively, and respond quickly to incidents
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to documentation and process
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including occasional evenings/weekends for changes or incidents
